fields.System.Title: INB-3 — Putaway
fields.System.Description:
Purpose

Get stock off the dock and into a legal storage location, quickly and to somewhere sensible.

Scope

In. Task generation, destination suggestion (simple then smart), confirmation, override
with a reason, consolidation, pick-face top-up, splitting, task timeout.

Out. Slotting strategy — deciding which products should live where is a separate
discipline.

Design notes

Build the suggestion twice, on purpose. INB-302 is deliberately dumb — first active
location that fits. INB-305 replaces it two stages later with capacity, zone, and
consolidation logic.

That is not wasted work. Six months of override reason codes from INB-304 is a specification
for the smart rule that no amount of up-front design would have produced. Make the override
reasons specific, and report on them.

Overrides are validated, not blindly accepted. The operator may choose a different
location; they may not choose an illegal one. Temperature zone, hazmat, weight, and mixing
rules still apply.

Re-validate capacity at scan time. The suggested location may have been filled by someone
else in the two minutes since the task was issued. Suggest an alternative immediately rather
than leaving the operator stuck at the shelf.

Risks

| Risk | Reference |
|---|---|
| Two operators claiming the same task | [doc 09 §4.3](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Task created before the receipt transaction commits | [doc 09 §2.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Stock put away physically but never confirmed | [doc 05 WF 3](../../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
| Suggested location full on arrival | [doc 05 WF 3](../../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
| Override reasons all defaulting to "other" | [doc 05 WF 3](../../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
| Null capacity producing nonsense suggestions | [doc 03 §7.4](../../../docs/03-master-data.md) |
